summary.title: 我负责一台用于石化园区和海上风电场甲烷泄漏巡检的短波红外成像相机前端防护窗口
summary.question: 我负责一台用于石化园区和海上风电场甲烷泄漏巡检的短波红外成像相机前端防护窗口研发。为了在白天强太阳背景下提高甲烷吸收特征的信噪比，相机需要尽可能完整地接收 1000–1700 nm 波段的短波红外信号，同时尽可能反射 300–450 nm 波段的近紫外和蓝光杂散辐射，以降低太阳散射背景和探测器的杂散响应。请在空气入射、熔融石英基底的条件下，仅使用 HfO2 和 SiO2 设计一个平面多层介质膜，膜系总层数不超过 30 层。

problem.compatibility_reason: Request specifies planar multilayer dielectric film with isotropic materials (HfO2, SiO2, Fused Silica) under plane-wave illumination, fitting TMM scope.

metrics.rationale: User requests '尽可能完整地接收 1000–1700 nm 波段的短波红外信号' (receive 1000-1700 nm SWIR signal as completely as possible) for methane absorption feature detection.
User requests '尽可能反射 300–450 nm 波段的近紫外和蓝光杂散辐射' (reflect 300-450 nm UV/blue stray radiation as much as possible) to reduce solar scattering background.

scoring.metric_rationale: These two metrics directly encode the dual-band requirement: high transmission in the methane-sensing SWIR band (1000-1700 nm) and high reflection in the UV/blue rejection band (300-450 nm). I deliberately omit absorption metrics since the user's goal is spectral filtering (transmit signal, reject background), not thermal management. I also omit worst-case metrics because the user says '尽可能' (as much as possible) which implies average performance optimization rather than guaranteeing every single wavelength point. Two metrics suffice; adding more would dilute the ranking without capturing additional user intent.
scoring.formula_rationale: The user requires both high transmission for methane detection and high reflection for background suppression, phrased as 'as completely as possible' for both bands. Since neither goal is prioritized over the other in the request, the expression adds the two metrics directly. Each term contributes positively because both variables have a 'maximize' direction, ensuring the score increases only when signal throughput improves or stray light rejection improves.

routes.title: Quarter-wave UV reflector with SWIR transmission window
routes.termination_reason: LLM explicitly assessed no further benefit after 2 executed rounds (stop_basis=marginal_gains_too_low)
routes.scientific_hypothesis: A periodic HfO2/SiO2 quarter-wave stack designed for high reflection at 375 nm (center of 300-450 nm) will produce transmission peaks at harmonic wavelengths including the 1000-1700 nm SWIR band, enabling simultaneous UV rejection and SWIR transmission.
routes.design_principle: Dielectric mirrors use constructive interference from alternating high/low index layers. Quarter-wave optical thickness at the target reflection wavelength creates maximum reflectance. Transmission windows occur at wavelengths where optical thickness equals half-integer multiples of the design wavelength.
routes.topology: Air | (HfO2/SiO2)_12 | Fused Silica substrate, 24 layers total, starting with HfO2 on the air side
known_risks: I recall HfO2 n≈2.0-2.1 and SiO2 n≈1.45-1.5 in visible/NIR but exact dispersion across 300-1700 nm is uncertain and must be read from registry data
Quarter-wave at 375 nm may not align perfectly with 1000-1700 nm transmission window - the 3rd harmonic would be ~125 nm and higher orders need verification
I am uncertain whether 12 pairs is optimal or if fewer pairs would suffice with better thickness tuning
Absorption in HfO2 below 400 nm is recalled but not quantified - could reduce UV reflectance efficiency
No angle specification in request - I assume normal incidence but this should be confirmed
